create_cartpole_env: create a CartPoleBulletEnv gym environment with discrete or continuous actions for reinforcement learning
run_step_simulation: run a single simulation step on the cartpole environment applying force and returning state reward and done
reset_cartpole_state: reset the cartpole simulation to a random initial state within small bounds around zero
render_cartpole_rgb: render the cartpole simulation as an RGB array image using the Bullet OpenGL camera
create_continuous_cartpole_env: create a CartPoleContinuousBulletEnv gym environment with continuous action space for reinforcement learning
